text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text: Open your eyes...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text:
Now jump, and shout... Ah, make sure
your light
stick matches your fav's
color...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Everyone having a blast?
Enjoying our duo
concert?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're finally awake, sleepyhead. ☆
C'mon,
start waving your light stick!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We finally made it to this arena!
The
glamorous stage, the stands filled
with lights—it's
all ours, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But we can get farther away yet. I
propose a new
goal. Next, our front
running will take us to...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Outer space.

text_block_list.name: Fans Floating in Space
text_block_list.text:
Yooo! It's the Runaway Sisters!
This is
awesome! Holy moly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Riiiing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aw, that bell means our time together is
up!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we just run away until we
can't hear it
anymore?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good point. After all, leading the pack
where no
one's gone before is what we
do!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's right, 'cause we're the...

text_block_list.name: Falco & Friends
text_block_list.text: Runaway Sisters! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Riiiing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer! So today...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello! This the studio we're using
today?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heyo! I'm here, just like you asked!
Tada!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm... Hello.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I asked everyone here if
we could
practice together today!
Because, well...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uh, Trainer? Are you... okay? You look
like you're
having a revelation or
something.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, we're about to get started, so
c'mon,
pay attention! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When us five harmonize, it's legendary!
You'll
give us a listen, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I listen to the five of them sing, and the
harmony
is as pleasing as Smart Falcon
promised.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Forming a unit to practice with might be
good for
<chrname>...
